text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A short while after the Osaka Hai.
Without even a moment to catch our breath, the gates opened for Satono Diamond's Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Satono Diamond is bumped slightly wide
by another Umamusume who stumbled!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
3rd place! The 1st favorite, Satono Diamond, finishes in 3rd!
She couldn't answer the crowd's expectations!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking on a GⅠ at long last.
It's no use moping around, but...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: —Now this is how it should be. This makes it all the more worth breaking...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The jinx that has held back the Satono family...
If it were something easily broken, someone would have broken it long ago.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Compared to usual years, the competition is tougher. There were disadvantages, too.
Even so, she knew what she was getting into.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"That's precisely why Dia is here...!
Next time, I will fulfill my mission—!"

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Dia-chan...! You're right, I can't let something like this get me down.
All right, count me in too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of an heiress of the Satono Group.
She literally possesses a heart of diamond.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Following today's defeat... Dia has already
started moving forward. Toward the Derby.
So..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Kita-chan and Trainer, please be sure to give another great run next time.
That will be the greatest encouragement for us.
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's give it our all, Kitasan.
Yeah, let's do our best, Kitasan.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yes! My race is first again.
I'll show them a run straight from the soul!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though running in different races, they continued training side by side,
competing with and inspiring each other.
The spring for these two—was still burning hot.
